title: 5.0 magnitude earthquake strikes Egypt
description: The quake occurred at 3 a.m. local time about 22 miles north ⁠of the Egyptian city of Suez, the US Geological Survey said.
content:
A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck off Egypt early on Monday, according to the United States Geological Survey.
